cases.reviewerAnswer: Not applicable: situation metadata covering daily routine, study, work and leisure.
Identify the action and its subject: «Trabajo» means I work; «Ana estudia» means Ana studies; «Comemos» means we eat.
Use «con» for company: «Hablo con mi madre» and «Ceno con mi familia».
Singular present endings: yo -o, tú -as, él/ella/usted -a.
Plural present endings: nosotros/nosotras -amos, vosotros/vosotras -áis, ellos/ellas/ustedes -an.
cases.notes: The statement about the vosotros accent is correctly scoped to the regular -ar present.

cases.reviewerAnswer: «comida»: feminine noun; plural «comidas»; food or a meal, including lunch in Spain.
«llegar»: «приходити, прибувати»; present forms include «llego, llegas, llega».
«tomar» can mean to take or to consume food or drink; «tomar un café» is natural Spain Spanish.
